changes: Require breaking PR review to acknowledge both merge-base and cumulative release scopes in one entry. Reject release artifacts whose machine-readable changes differ from the versioned changelog, using immutable tagged notes when the release tag exists.

Align public health examples with the prepared contract version, recognize wrapped breaking-review bullets without crossing bullet/heading boundaries, and retain strict candidate/full-rollout health checks while recording legacy previous-version responses only during verified partial rollouts.

Separate saved `PostProviderOptions` from complete `ProviderPublishOptions`. Post targets retain YouTube visibility with an unanswered audience and TikTok privacy/disclosure choices before completion. Scheduling rejects unanswered choices or an enabled disclosure without a subtype; draft-only `disclose_commercial_content` never enters Distribution publication options.

Publish source-bound, automatically versioned contract release artifacts with JSON/YAML, checksums, and machine-readable change notes. Gate PR and release compatibility against their real bases; intentional breaks require a fresh exact-change changelog review. Public health consumers retain Git-SHA deployment checks while validating the distinct contract version. Promote only `getHealth` to `worker-preview` with immutable hosted release/conformance evidence.

Add required `Health.contract_version` to unauthenticated `GET /health`, distinct from the application `version`. Clients compare this machine-readable contract version before login or mutation; the server does not reject older clients.

**Breaking:** `POST /oauth-selections/{selection_id}/confirm` (`OAuthSelectionConfirmRequest`) now requires `brand_profile_id` alongside `account_id`. Clients must send the active Brand Profile UUID that will own the connected Channel; authorization no longer selects that owner in advance.

Add `GET /analytics/dashboard` (`getAnalyticsDashboard`) with daily series, best-time cells, format and platform breakdowns, follower history, and engagement accumulation. Its required `cohort` field carries the same published-cohort `AnalyticsSummary` as `GET /analytics`, so a client renders KPIs, coverage, and the platform comparison from one request. Add required `AnalyticsPostRow.synced_destination_count` so a partially synced Post is distinguishable from a fully measured one. `unavailable_metrics` enumerates only the metrics a Provider does not expose (`saves`, `clicks`, `followers`).

Add `GET /analytics/posts` (`getAnalyticsPosts`), the documented per-Post analytics read ranked by `views`, `likes`, `comments`, or `shares` with stable `limit`/`offset` pagination. Add nullable `PlatformMetrics.last_synced_at` so a Platform awaiting its first snapshot is distinguishable from a measured zero. `getAnalyticsSummary` now cohorts on `published_at` and derives `partial`/`unsupported_platforms` from the published Platforms actually in scope rather than every registered Platform. All changes are additive at the contract boundary.

Add paired `queue_assigned_from` (inclusive) and `queue_assigned_before` (exclusive) filters to `listPosts`, requiring `queue_id` and a window of at most 63 days. Queue calendars read immutable assignments without scanning unrelated Post history; existing pagination remains unchanged.

Add Brand Profile-scoped recurring publishing Queues (`listQueues`, `createQueue`, `getQueue`, `updateQueue`, `deleteQueue`), explicit pending membership removal (`removePostFromQueue`), `Post.queue_membership` and the `queue_id` Post filter. Scheduling accepts exactly one of `queue_id` or `scheduled_at`; null still publishes immediately. Queue reservations are immutable across configuration edits; gaps skip and overlaps choose the post-transition instant. Existing delivery and reconciliation remain unchanged.

Add required nullable `Post.analytics`, with latest-snapshot totals across published Channels for likes, comments, shares, views, impressions, and reach. Missing snapshots produce null rather than invented zeros; saves and clicks remain null until collected. Add required `Post.distribution_analytics`, the latest measured snapshot per published Distribution, so the Post inspector can compare Channels without a second request. Calendar reads exclude soft-deleted Posts while preserving their Distribution history.

Add `GET /api/auth/setup-status` and require `X-Setup-Secret` for initial `POST /api/auth/sign-up/email`. Registration closes after the installation's sole owner exists; document closed-registration and missing-configuration errors.
Reduce `SignUpEmailRequest.name` maximum length from 200 to 100 characters. Change `VerifyEmailResult.user` from `AuthUser` to nullable `AuthUser | null`.

Add verification resend and authenticator enrollment, confirmation, backup-code verification/replacement, and disabling contracts. Sign-in can return a pending factor challenge instead of an authenticated token; deployed signup can return a null token until email verification. Align factor responses with Better Auth.
Bind application bearer JWTs to live owner sessions. Revoked, expired, and superseded sessions no longer authorize protected application operations.

Remove `/billing/webhook`, `/billing/plan`, `/billing/usage`, `/billing/checkout-sessions`, and `/billing/portal-sessions`, plus their payment requests, responses, status, and paid-plan schemas. Remove `plan` from `OrganizationSummary` and `Workspace`. Clients must use the community resource policy rather than subscription or checkout APIs.

Add explicit OAuth account selection endpoints for multi-account providers: `GET /oauth-selections/{selection_id}` (`getOAuthSelection`), `POST /oauth-selections/{selection_id}/confirm` (`confirmOAuthSelection`), and `DELETE /oauth-selections/{selection_id}` (`cancelOAuthSelection`) with `OAuthSelection`, `OAuthSelectionAccount`, and `OAuthSelectionConfirmRequest` schemas. Requests are scoped by `X-Workspace-ID` and authorized via bearer tokens; mutations require `Idempotency-Key`. Document that `GET /platforms/{platform}/callback` may redirect (302) to the Page picker view before persistence.
Add required nullable `username` property (max 255 chars) to `PlatformAccount` and `OAuthSelectionAccount` for truthful external provider handle representation.

Establish Better Auth cookie session transport (`cookieAuth`, same-origin `better-auth.session_token`) and the browser auth lifecycle under `/api/auth/*`: sign-in, sign-up, sign-out, get-session, request-password-reset, reset-password, verify-email, and change-password.

Add the optional `X-Workspace-ID` request header to every authenticated `/api/v1` operation; the server resolves the caller's org_members membership and role for the selected workspace before it becomes the actor/RLS claims.

Add the native workspace lifecycle: `POST /workspaces`, `PATCH /workspaces/{workspaceId}`, `POST /workspaces/{workspaceId}/invitations`, `POST /workspace-invitations/{token}/accept`, `DELETE /workspaces/{workspaceId}/invitations/{invitationId}`, `PATCH /workspaces/{workspaceId}/members/{memberId}`, and `DELETE /workspaces/{workspaceId}/members/{memberId}` with the `admin`/`member` role domain.
Add `GET /assets/{asset_id}/preview-url` so validated ready media can be rendered from a short-lived private URL without weakening the existing attachment-only download response.

Add the Post-owned media composition surface: `GET /posts`, `POST /posts`, `GET /posts/{post_id}`, `PATCH /posts/{post_id}`, `DELETE /posts/{post_id}`, and `POST /posts/{post_id}/schedule` (`listPosts`, `createPost`, `getPost`, `updatePost`, `deletePost`, `schedulePost`). One durable `Post` owns its default text, ordered `attachments`, saved per-Channel `targets`, and independent `distributions`; a draft persists without any Channel selection, and scheduling or publishing preserves the same Post identity.

Require `brand_profile_id` and an `Idempotency-Key` on every Post mutation, and reject attempts to persist a Post with neither text nor attachments. `POST /posts/{post_id}/schedule` accepts a nullable `scheduled_at` (null publishes immediately) and creates or updates only still-editable pending Distributions, leaving claimed, published, and reconciliation-bound outcomes unchanged.

Replace `Distribution.asset_id` with `Distribution.post_id`, filter `GET /distributions` by `post_id`, and carry `post_id` on `CalendarEvent` (as `post_id`/`post_title`), `AnalyticsSnapshot`, and `InboxComment`.

Add nullable `Distribution.publication`: the immutable frozen snapshot of the newest claimed publish attempt (`DistributionPublication` with title, text, hashtags, provider options, and ordered media identities), null until an attempt claims the Channel.

Add `PlatformCapability.max_media_count`, `min_media_count`, and `multi_asset_types` as the authority for per-Channel attachment bounds; `AssetType` is now `image|video`, so text-only permission is expressed by `min_media_count`.

Narrow `Asset` to post-owned media by dropping `text_content`, `description`, and `tags`; `CreateUploadSessionRequest` drops `description` and `tags` and keeps its required `title`. Accepted upload formats and size limits are unchanged.

Remove the standalone media library and asset-centric composition contracts without replacement shims: `GET /assets`, `POST /assets`, `POST /assets/upload-url`, `DELETE /assets/{asset_id}`, `POST /distributions`, and `POST /distribution-batches`. Assets remain reachable only through the required scoped composer, preview, download, and upload-session operations, and abandoned media is reclaimed by ownership-aware orphan cleanup rather than a user-facing delete.
